entries.title: Proverbs 22:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: 1Ki 1:47; Ec 7:1; Lu 10:20; Php 4:3; Heb 11:39 loving favour rather than. or, favour is better than, etc. Ac 7:10

entries.title: Proverbs 22:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: By, etc. Heb. The reward of humility, etc. 3:16; 21:21; Ps 34:9,10; 112:1-3; Isa 33:6; 57:15; Mt 6:33; 1Ti 4:8 Jas 4:6,10

entries.title: Proverbs 22:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Train up. or, Catechize. a child. Ge 18:19; De 4:9; 6:7; Ps 78:3-6; Eph 6:4; 2Ti 3:15 the way. Heb. his way. when. 1Sa 1:28; 2:26; 12:2,3

entries.title: Proverbs 22:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: rich. 16,22; 14:31; 18:23; Am 2:6; 4:1; 5:11,12; 8:4,6; Jas 2:6; 5:1,4 the borrower. 2Ki 4:1; Ne 5:4,5; Isa 24:2; Mt 18:25 lender. Heb. man that lendeth.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: that. Job 4:8; Ho 8:7; 10:13; Ga 6:7,8 the rod of his anger shall fail. or, with the rod of hisanger he shall be consumed. 14:3; Ps 125:3; Isa 9:4; 10:5; 14:29; 30:31

entries.title: Proverbs 22:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: that. 16:13; Ps 101:6; Mt 5:8 for the grace of his lips. or, and hath grace in his lips. Ps 45:2; Lu 4:22 the king. Ge 41:39-57; Ezr 7:6-11; Ne 2:4-6; Es 10:3; Da 2:46-49; 3:30 Da 6:20-23

entries.title: Proverbs 22:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
The slothful.That is, the slothful man uses any pretext, however improbable, to indulge his love of ease and indolence.

15:19; 26:13-16; Nu 13:32,33

entries.title: Proverbs 22:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
mouth. 2:16-19; 5:3-23; 6:24-29; 7:5-27; 23:27; Jud 16:20,21; Ne 13:26 Ec 7:26 a deep pit.That is, it is like a deep pit, or pitfall, in which animals are often taken alive.

abhorred. De 32:19; Ps 81:12

entries.title: Proverbs 22:19
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: thy. 3:5; Ps 62:8; Isa 12:2; 26:4; Jer 17:7; 1Pe 1:21 even to thee. or, trust thou also.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:21
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I. Lu 1:3,4; Joh 20:31; 1Jo 5:13 answer. 1Pe 3:15 them that send unto thee. or, those that send thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:22
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Rob. 23:10,11; Eze 22:29 oppress. 16; Ex 23:6; Job 29:12-16; 31:16,21; Zec 7:10; Mal 3:5 in the gate.That is, in the court of justice, which, as we have already seen, was held at the gates of cities in the East.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:29
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
a man. 10:4; 12:24; 1Ki 11:28; Ec 9:10; Mt 25:21,23; Ro 12:11; 2Ti 4:2 he shall stand.That is, he shall have the honour of serving kings; as the phrase denotes.

mean men. Heb. obscure men.
